opportunities.title: City of Ekurhuleni 2027 Community Bursary
opportunities.opportunity_type: Community bursary for 2027 full-time undergraduate study in selected fields
opportunities.eligibility: South African citizen permanently residing in Ekurhuleni; age 18–35; completed Grade 12; accepted or registered for 2027 study; household income at or below R600,000. Check the official notice for full qualification and field requirements.
opportunities.application_status: Open per official notice; application portal error observed 14 November 2026
opportunities.summary: The City's official notice invites qualifying residents to apply. The application portal returned an unhandled error when checked; read the notice and retry the portal.
opportunities.application_steps: Register and activate a profile on the City portal, choose Community Bursary, complete and submit the form, and retain the reference number. The notice lists certified ID, proof of residence, household income, and 2027 acceptance or registration documents.
opportunities.review_record: Official City notice and application portal checked on 14 November 2026. The notice confirms applications are open; the portal returned an unhandled error.

opportunities.eligibility: South African citizens aged 18–35 with relevant or potential enterprise skills; additional business criteria and exclusions apply.
opportunities.location: South Africa; check the NYDA branch or portal for service access.
opportunities.application_status: Programme information available; no fixed closing date stated
opportunities.closing_date: No closing date stated on the official programme page.
opportunities.summary: Financial and non-financial support for eligible young entrepreneurs. Confirm the full criteria and current application process with NYDA.
opportunities.application_steps: Register on the NYDA portal, submit the required documents and business management training proof, complete the business pitch, and undergo NYDA due diligence. Confirm the current process with NYDA.
